panels.description: Alex scans his identity band at the checkpoint while Foreman-7 stands beside the node. Keep the upper checkpoint clear.
Alex's band displays the debt transfer, Adrian's whereabouts unrecorded, 418,607-credit balance and 28.7-year clearance projection. Keep the upper display clear.
Alex covers Adrian's worn steel watch with his thumb. Keep the upper frame empty.
The checkpoint shutter opens toward the closed, dust-covered Last Chance bar. Keep the upper shutter area clear.
